messages:
maria: Hey @eng-oncall — PR #4123 is red on CI. Only failing test I see is tests/integration/test_rate_limiter.py::test_burst. Looks flaky/transient based on past runs. Can someone do a surgical rerun of just the failing job (no image rebuild) ?

ci-bot: check run failed: integration-suite (job id: 1234567) — logs: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/actions/runs/456789012

jay: I can kick that. We use GitHub Actions for that workflow. Important: rerun the specific job ID (1234567) instead of the whole workflow to avoid rebuilds.

anita: Quick note — there are two API options: rerun the job or rerun the workflow. Job rerun preserves built artifacts/caches. From GH CLI you can run:
```
# rerun a single job (preferred to avoid rebuild)
gh api -X POST /repos/redwood/redwood/actions/jobs/1234567/rerun -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"
```
If you only have the workflow run id, you can list jobs to find the job id:
```
# list jobs for a run
gh api /repos/redwood/redwood/actions/runs/456789012/jobs -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" | jq '.jobs[] | {id: .id, name: .name, status: .status}'
```
(Replace ids with the ones you see.)

sam: If someone doesn't have gh set up, you can also do it from the Actions UI: open the run -> Jobs -> click the job -> Re-run job. That also avoids rebuilding unrelated artifacts.

jay: For completeness, DO NOT trigger a workflow_dispatch with a build param or call the top-level rerun workflow if you're just chasing a flaky test — that forces image rebuilds and can take >30m. Rerunning job id 1234567 should be ~5-8m.

leo: If the job uses docker layers from our cache, rerunning the job will still benefit from the cache. If you see failures due to missing cache keys, then we may need a full rerun but try single-job first.

anita: If the job fails again deterministically, leave a note here and ping @eng-infra — we'll do a bisect or add a temporary skip. :warning:

maria: Thanks all — I don't have gh configured, can someone hit the job rerun in the UI? I can monitor.

jay: Done — I re-ran job 1234567 via the UI. Will post results in a few mins. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: job 1234567 re-run queued (run id: 456789013)

ci-bot: job 1234567 re-run completed — status: success ✅

maria: Awesome, tests are green again. Thanks team!

anita: Filed a short note on the PR about flake and added it to flaky-tests tracking board so we can triage if it repeats.

maria: Perfect. Closing the loop here.
